name: King Beelak & Queen Beenerdim
source:
Beelak is an excellent ruler, described as one of the greatest leaders in the entire history of the Beeliver race. Beenerdim is portrayed as a wise queen whose words and advice Beelak always valued and followed.

At the same time, Beelak is a distant father who, for the sake of succession rules and Beeliver tradition, stopped taking interest in raising his daughter. Beenerdim, on the other hand, adored her child up until her death from illness—showering her with maternal love, spoiling her with gifts and treats, and telling her bedtime stories every night.

Nothing is known about the past of either ruler. By the beginning of the events of The Beexen’s Tale, Beenerdim has died from a severe illness, and Beelak has been killed by Beexen.
